periods.time: After the final battle, before the public wedding sequence

name.zh: 爱理病中护理与兄妹和解

periods.summary: Airi collapses from the burden of piloting Jormungandr in the final battle. Noct cares for her, then arranges for Lux to nurse her. Lux and Airi confront their mutual dependence and Airi chooses to keep supporting him as schedule manager and future ruins adviser.
periods.cause: Airi overused a Divine Drag-Ride beyond her physical limits to help defeat Fugil.
periods.process: Airi dreams of her post-revolution reunion with Lux, receives care from Lux and Noct, discusses her future and tests Lux's motives for caring for her.
periods.outcome: Airi stops trying to detach from Lux and reclaims support of him as her own dream.
periods.aftermath: She begins managing Lux's schedule and aims toward ruins-related civil work.
periods.significance: Defines Airi's postwar role and resolves her fear of losing her purpose after Lux becomes king and husband.
